text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, did you hear? In the upcoming mock race...
Opera O-san, Top Road-san, and Ayabe-san are all running!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Man~ that lineup is way too stacked for a mock race. Oh, speak of the devil...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's finally next week!
How are everyone's preparations going?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hwahaha! Preparations, you ask?
Unnecessary! For I am already promised a glorious, radiant victory!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You really never change, do you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Whenever I race upon the turf, there is always a triumphant victory that enraptures all—that is the destiny I was born to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, such incredible confidence...
As expected of Opera O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: ...Well~, in the end, it's just a mock race. Maybe she's just taking it a little lightly?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—I happened to catch sight of Narita Top Road hard at work doing running drills.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh. Ayabe-san, are you getting in shape for the mock race too... by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............
And while we're at it... there's one more over there.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Doto. Forgive me, but could you accompany me for another five sets... no, ten sets?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: T-Ten sets, you sayy?! U-Um, I don't mind, but aren't you pushing yourself too hard?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Nay, worry not. There is no chance something of this level could ever dim the radiance of the Overlord.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
After all...
I have an important stage to perform on next week!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Opera O-chan is, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...In the end... no matter what stage it is, cutting corners in a race is out of the question.
Whether it's for us—or for her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm heading out now.
See you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! I'm really looking forward to the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so... the day of the mock race arrived.

text_block_list.name: Three Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The three of them delivered such a fierce, neck-and-neck battle that spectators could easily have mistaken it for an official race!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hwahaha! Listen to the cheers of joy from the gallery! Behold the spectators blessed with the supreme fortune of witnessing our duel!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Right now, I take pride from the bottom of my heart in having shared such a sublime stage with the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: As always... you never make things easy for me...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
That was truly a wonderful race...!
choice_data_list: Maybe it was because it was you three that you got so fired up.
You really know how to liven up any stage, don't you?
You always bring the energy to any stage.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
That was truly a wonderful race...!
choice_data_list: Maybe it was because it was you three that you got so fired up.
You really know how to liven up any stage, don't you?
You always bring the energy to any stage.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Of course! Whenever I think about running with those two, I'm just filled with the burning desire not to lose... and pure joy!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My conviction has only deepened once more. You two are truly indispensable to my grand tale—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall look forward to our next encounter upon another stage before long! Hwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was a moment where everyone bore witness to a truly marvelous "stage."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! But of course! Just as I said before!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That I should be enveloped in glorious radiance... that is a predetermined fate! The one and only unshakeable destiny!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You certainly talk big.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was a moment where everyone bore witness to a truly marvelous "stage."
